# Health Plus International — factual reference

Health Plus International is a healthcare workforce development business in Helensburgh, NSW. HPI recruits, employs and places healthcare workers in Sydney and regional NSW. 

## Roles

- Registered nurses
- Assistants in nursing
- Aged care workers
- Support workers: community and in-home support, not NDIS
- Allied health professionals

Role-specific checks are described at https://healthplusint.com.au/roles.
HPI employs the workers. The facility chooses who it accepts and directs day-to-day work and clinical supervision. Site induction is agreed with the facility in the mobilisation plan.

## For employers

Send a request and we acknowledge it the same business day. We contact you within 24 hours, and we will be straightforward about what we can fill. Not ready to commit? Ask about a trial engagement in the request.

What you receive: a verified role brief; a qualified shortlist; a readiness summary for each worker; a mobilisation plan; early-placement follow-up; performance reporting.

Employer request: https://healthplusint.com.au/employers#request

## For healthcare workers

Register in two short steps. We review your details and contact you about roles that may suit you. We ask for documents and checks only for roles that fit.

Please do not send identity, banking, police-check or health information with your first details.

Worker registration: https://healthplusint.com.au/work-with-us#apply
Privacy policy: https://healthplusint.com.au/privacy

## Where we work

Sydney, and regional NSW in six areas. Regional work is planned for each engagement. Listing a region does not mean a vacancy is open.

- Far West NSW: Broken Hill, Menindee, Wilcannia and Tibooburra
- Western NSW: Dubbo, Bourke, Walgett, Lightning Ridge and Cobar
- Murrumbidgee: Griffith, Wagga Wagga, Deniliquin and Hay
- Hunter New England: Tamworth, Armidale, Moree, Narrabri and Inverell
- Northern NSW: Lismore, Grafton, Ballina, Casino and Byron Bay
- Mid North Coast: Port Macquarie, Coffs Harbour, Kempsey and Taree

Regional details and map: https://healthplusint.com.au/employers#where-we-work

## Partners

We work with the Multicultural Communities Support Centre (MCCSC) to support candidates into healthcare work. The pathway has three steps: HPI, MCCSC, host facility. No visa category or overseas origin is assumed; each person's work rights and qualifications are verified individually.

About and Service charter: https://healthplusint.com.au/about
FAQ: https://healthplusint.com.au/faq
